Run rule flags on an artifact snapshot

run_flags.Rd

Applies each FlagRule to its target domain and combines non-empty outputs.

Usage

run_flags(artifact, rules)

Arguments

artifact

An ArtifactSnapshot.

rules

List of FlagRule objects.

Value

A data.frame of flagged rows augmented with rule metadata columns (RULE_ID, DOMAIN, SEVERITY, CATEGORY, OWNER_TEAM).

Examples

dom <- new_domain_snapshot(
  name = "ADVS",
  data = example_advs(),
  key_vars = c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVISIT")
)
art <- new_artifact_snapshot(domains = list(ADVS = dom))
rule <- new_flag_rule(
  id = "HI_SYSBP",
  domain = "ADVS",
  fn = function(df) {
    out <- df[df$PARAMCD == "SYSBP" & !is.na(df$AVAL) & df$AVAL > 145, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(out)) return(data.frame())
    out[, c("USUBJID", "PARAMCD", "AVAL"), drop = FALSE]
  }
)
run_flags(art, list(rule))
#>       USUBJID PARAMCD AVAL  RULE_ID DOMAIN SEVERITY CATEGORY OWNER_TEAM
#> 5 STUDY01-003   SYSBP  150 HI_SYSBP   ADVS  warning  quality   Biostats
